description: A professional cellist needs to create a comprehensive instrument maintenance portfolio spreadsheet for insurance documentation. Open the raw repair receipts file at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/receipts_raw.txt containing 12 service records from 8 years spanning 4 instruments. Create a structured maintenance log with proper columns (Date, Instrument, Service, Luthier/Shop, Cost, Notes). Enter all 12 service records. Use formulas to calculate total maintenance costs per instrument and total investment (purchase price + maintenance) for each. Flag upcoming maintenance items visually. Create a summary section showing: Instrument Name, Purchase Price, Total Maintenance Cost, Total Investment, Status. Save the spreadsheet as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/instrument_portfolio.xlsx.
